weaknesses: Abstract lacks clarity in articulating the significance of the proposed benchmark compared to existing ones.
The claims regarding the performance of LLMs in tool selection are overstated; results indicate more nuanced performance variations.
The limitations of the dataset ToolE are not sufficiently discussed, particularly regarding potential biases in user queries.
The empirical analysis section lacks detailed statistical methods used for evaluating LLM performance, making it difficult to assess rigor.
strengths: The introduction of the ToolE dataset is a significant contribution, addressing the need for diverse and realistic user queries.
The paper provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating tool usage awareness and selection capabilities in LLMs.
The error analysis offers valuable insights into the performance gaps of LLMs, guiding future research directions.
The structure of the paper is logical, with clear delineation of tasks and subtasks, aiding reader comprehension.
